title: Digital Marketing and CRM Specialist (Hubspot)
description:
Our client supplies specialist products to customers across the transport sector. It's an established business with a reach well beyond the UK, and its EMEA marketing team has plenty happening. They're looking for someone who can bring their digital and CRM experience to the team and make a real impact across the region.

The Role - DIGITAL MARKETING & CRM SPECIALIST

If you know your way around HubSpot and want more room to use it properly, this could be a very good next step. You'll take ownership of the CRM across EMEA while working on websites, marketing automation and the digital journeys that turn interest into enquiries. You'll be working closely with sales and marketing colleagues in different countries, helping them get more from HubSpot and giving them a clearer picture of what's working. It's a varied, hands-on role with the freedom to spot an opportunity and do something about it.

Key Responsibilities - DIGITAL MARKETING & CRM SPECIALIST
- Take day-to-day ownership of HubSpot across EMEA, from contact data and segmentation to workflows and reporting.
- Help sales and marketing teams use the CRM consistently and follow up leads effectively.
- Build and improve automated campaigns and lead nurturing journeys.
- Keep the regional websites and ecommerce platform up to date, including product content and landing pages.
- Use analytics to improve website journeys, engagement and conversions.
- Support SEO and keep an eye on how customers are finding businesses through search and AI tools.
- Work with colleagues, agencies and global stakeholders to turn ideas into improvements.

About You - DIGITAL MARKETING & CRM SPECIALIST

You're a capable digital marketer with strong, practical HubSpot experience. That's the essential bit. You understand how CRM supports both marketing and sales, and you're comfortable getting into the detail of data, campaigns and reporting.

Experience with websites, marketing automation and SEO would be useful, as would a background in B2 B or a technical industry. If you speak French or German, even better, but neither language is essential. What matters most is that you're organised, enjoy working with different people and are ready to take more ownership in a role with international scope.

The office is near Colchester. You'll work there every day for your first two weeks while you get to know the business and the team and after that, it's a hybrid arrangement with two days a week in the office.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Our client, a dynamic and innovative organisation in the building and construction sector, is seeking a passionate Marketing Executive to elevate their brand and drive strategic marketing initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in a thriving industry, where creativity meets construction.

About the Role:

As a Marketing Executive, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation's marketing strategy. This position involves a diverse range of responsibilities, including:

Developing and implementing effective marketing campaigns to promote the organisation's products and services.
- Conducting market research to identify new opportunities and emerging trends within the construction sector.
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to produce compelling content that resonates with target audiences.
- Managing social media channels and digital marketing efforts to enhance online presence and engagement.
- Monitoring and analysing campaign performance metrics to optimise strategies for maximum impact.
- Assisting in the planning and execution of promotional events and exhibitions.

Key Requirements:

To be considered for this exciting role, candidates should possess the following qualifications and skills:

A degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
- Proven experience in marketing, preferably within the building and construction industry.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies, including SEO, PPC, and social media marketing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for crafting engaging content.
- Proficiency in marketing software and tools, such as Google Analytics, Mailchimp, or HubSpot.
- Creative thinker with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

What's on Offer:

Our client values talent and is committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. The successful candidate will enjoy:
- A competitive salary package commensurate with experience.
- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
- A vibrant workplace culture that encourages innovation and collaboration.
- Flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance.

Why Join Our Client?

This is not just another marketing role; it's a chance to be part of a forward-thinking organisation that is shaping the future of the construction industry. If you are enthusiastic about marketing and eager to contribute to a growing company, this opportunity is for you!

How to Apply:

Don't miss out on the chance to join an organisation that values creativity and innovation in the building and construction sector. Take the next step in your career and be part of something great!

title: Marketing Manager
description:
MARKETING MANAGER WICKFORD, ESSEX BASIC SALARY CIRCA £50k

What's the deal

At a time when many in the market are standing still, this family-run manufacturer is powering ahead. Turnover has more than doubled since we started working with them, driven by new products, five own brands and major investment across internal sales, field sales, and marketing.

Despite that growth, the business has kept everything that makes it special: exceptional people, down-to-earth leadership, quick decisions, and genuine trust. Now it needs a Marketing Manager to build on that momentum, raise the profile of its brands and play a key role in an exciting next chapter.

Your mission
- This is a hands-on role with room to think big. You'll set the direction, roll up your sleeves, and make sure great Ideas actually leave the whiteboard.
- Build and own a marketing plan that turns growth goals into campaigns people notice-and act on.
- Get close to customers, competitors, and market trends, turning insights into sharper positioning.
- Bring the brand to life across the website, social media, email, content, advertising, brochures, and sales tools.
- Plan and deliver launches, promotions, exhibitions, and trade campaigns from bright idea to brilliant execution.
- Work with sales, product teams, leaders, agencies, and suppliers so marketing is joined-up, useful and timely.
- Own the marketing calendar and budget, choosing the right channels instead of doing what's always been done.
- Track numbers, leads, engagement, conversion, revenue, and ROI-and use them to improve the next campaign.

The kind of person we're looking for
- Marketing Manager experience, ideally in B2 B, manufacturing, high volume construction products.
- Equal parts strategist and doer: shaping plans, writing briefs, and stepping in when deadlines need rescuing.
- A confident communicator who inspires enthusiasm and keeps everyone moving together.
- Creative, commercially minded, and curious about what makes customers tick.
- Comfortable with digital tools, campaign data, and budgets-you don't need to love spreadsheets but must understand them.
- Organised, proactive and low ego; comfortable with autonomy, collaboration and making a visible difference.

The Package
- Circa £50k basic
- 25 days' holiday + bank holidays
- Real autonomy, supportive leadership, and a role with genuine influence

Sound like your kind of move?

If you can turn a blank page into a campaign, a spreadsheet into a decision and 'we should probably market that' into something customers notice, we'd love to hear from you. This is your chance to shape the marketing function, make your mark and have some fun doing it.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager - Fashion Brand

We are partnered with a fast-growing UK fashion retailer known for its trend-led, affordable collections and strong digital presence. With a loyal customer base, frequent new launches and continued investment in ecommerce and customer experience, the business has established itself as a leading name in accessible fashion.

The Role:

This is a unique opportunity for a Social Media Manager to take ownership of the entire social media function for an exciting and growing fashion brand. You will be responsible for developing and delivering a multi-platform social media strategy, building a consistent and premium brand identity while driving meaningful engagement, brand awareness and commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement the overall social media strategy, establishing clear objectives and growth plans across all platforms.
- Build and lead the social media function, managing and mentoring Content Creators and supporting their development.
- Own the brand's presence across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, creating tailored strategies for each platform.
- Develop a premium, aspirational social identity that appeals to a more mature fashion audience.
- Lead the planning, creation and delivery of engaging and commercially effective social content.
- Create, film, edit and publish high-quality video and photographic content across organic social and paid advertising.
- Lead creative direction for campaigns, product launches, seasonal collections and key brand moments.
- Plan and manage content shoots, including booking models, styling looks and coordinating production schedules.
- Work closely with the in-house photographer and wider Marketing team to deliver high-quality creative.
- Own the social media content calendar, ensuring campaigns, launches, Stories and promotional activity are planned and delivered effectively.
- Maintain a consistent brand identity, tone of voice and visual direction across all social channels.
- Analyse social media performance and use data and insights to continually improve content, engagement, reach and conversion.
- Identify new opportunities to grow the brand through social-first campaigns, trends, creators and innovative content formats.
- Stay ahead of developments across social platforms, fashion trends, consumer behaviour and algorithms.
- Confidently appear on camera when required and direct talent during content shoots.
- Work collaboratively with the wider Marketing and Brand teams to ensure social activity supports wider commercial and brand objectives.

About You:
- 3+ years' experience in social media management, ideally within a fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-platform social media strategies.
- Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading Content Creators or a social media team.
- A strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube, including platform-specific best practice and emerging trends.
- Excellent video creation, editing and creative storytelling skills, with a strong portfolio of work.
- A highly creative eye with a strong understanding of premium fashion and lifestyle content.

Why Apply?
- Opportunity to build and shape the social strategy from the ground up.
- Lead and mentor a growing team of Content Creators.
- Work for an established and growing fashion and footwear brand with exciting plans for the future.
- Take ownership across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
- Combine strategy, leadership and hands-on content creation in one role.
- Have real creative influence over the brand's premium and aspirational social identity.
